video_title: Boogie, Lou & Chandler Debate if Nuggets & Jokic’s Window is CLOSED???

quotes.speaker: Chandler Parsons
quotes.summary_phrase: Chandler Parsons and DeMarcus Cousins on the Nuggets' championship potential
quotes.excerpt: When you have two guys like that that have that much chemistry, they're always going to have an opportunity to compete.

text_blocks.speaker: Chandler Parsons
text_blocks.text: When you start talking about top five players, you have to. They have Jokic, they have Murray. I saw an interesting stat last night that they have a thousand assists to each other. That is a dynamic one-two punch. When you have two guys like that that have that much chemistry, and have won a championship together, and played x amount of years together, they're always going to have an opportunity to compete. I like what Christian Braun is bringing to the table. I like DeMar DeRozan being another guy that you can rely on to finish plays in the fourth quarter with Aaron Gordon. I think they have a great group of veteran guys that know what it looks like to win, know what it takes to win, and I think they'll give a lot of teams some headaches if they can keep it together.

text_blocks.speaker: DeMarcus Cousins
text_blocks.text: I agree, and they have Jokic. We know how good he is, and we know this team has that consistency. They have the foundation, they've been together for a long time. So the slow start was a little interesting, and it made some people think their window is closing. I don't really look at them like that. I think they're going to be one of those teams that's going to be the six seed, the third seed, and the third seed is going to be like, damn, we got Denver first round. It's going to be nothing easy. You're going to have to deal with Jokic and Murray and the way they're playing. We know how elite it can be.

quotes.speaker: DeMarcus Cousins
quotes.summary_phrase: DeMarcus Cousins believes the Nuggets' championship window is closed
quotes.excerpt: I do think the championship window is closed.
quotes.quote: I think they're still a good team, I think they're still a dangerous team, but I do think the championship window is closed. They don't quite have the shooting that we're accustomed to seeing from this group. The team defense isn't quite up to par with what we're accustomed to seeing. Still a dangerous team, still a good team, obviously a threat every night with a player like Jokic. He's going to do what he does, but I believe the championship window is closed.

quotes.speaker: Chandler Parsons
quotes.summary_phrase: Chandler Parsons and DeMarcus Cousins on the Nuggets' roster construction
quotes.excerpt: I don't think Denver has done a great job of surrounding him with the talent necessary.

text_blocks.speaker: Chandler Parsons
text_blocks.text: More so based on how good the other teams are, or a little bit of both? I think they're one of those teams that you just look at at the end of the season and they're right there, and they're going to be a tough out come playoff time if they're healthy.

text_blocks.speaker: DeMarcus Cousins
text_blocks.text: A little bit of both. I don't think Denver has done a great job of surrounding him with the talent necessary. And like I said, since they let Mike Malone go, it's kind of been a slow downhill fall for them. And then like you said, with the rest of the West, everybody is getting better. I think it's a combination of both, and like I said, I don't think Denver has done a great job of surrounding him with the talent necessary.

quotes.speaker: Michelle Beadle
quotes.summary_phrase: Michelle Beadle discusses the Charlotte Hornets' struggles
quotes.excerpt: They've lost nine of their last ten. LaMelo Ball's only played in a single game this year.
quotes.quote: Real quick on the Hornets, just because we can, and they're four and ten. We don't talk about them much and I don't know that we will, but their loss to the Lakers just got them at four and ten. They've lost nine of their last ten. LaMelo Ball's only played in a single game this year. And you know it's crazy because they were such a sort of fun watch, feel good, like oh look at this scrappy team they're putting together out there, Chandler. And now it's you got to regret trading LaMelo, but did you have to?

quotes.speaker: Chandler Parsons
quotes.summary_phrase: Chandler Parsons on LaMelo Ball's impact in Charlotte
quotes.excerpt: His production there and the excitement and what he did for that team is undeniable.
quotes.quote: Love him or hate him, I think his production there and the excitement and what he did for that team is undeniable. He's so talented. He made life easier for Brandon Miller, who is seeing right now it might not be as easy. Obviously they're going to be a better team with LaMelo, who had an unbelievable year. I love the addition of Naz Reid. Kobe Bufkin is also their starting point guard who is more of a score-first guy, so they don't really have that true set-up point guard. But yeah, it's a little bit of a slow start, but I think they're just realizing life after LaMelo Ball isn't as easy or sweet as you thought it would be.

quotes.speaker: DeMarcus Cousins
quotes.summary_phrase: DeMarcus Cousins criticizes the Hornets' front office
quotes.excerpt: Another bad organization that mishandled the talent and misunderstood the talent.
quotes.quote: Another bad organization that mishandled the talent and misunderstood the talent.

quotes.speaker: Chandler Parsons
quotes.summary_phrase: Chandler Parsons, DeMarcus Cousins, and Lou Williams on the Hornets' minute restriction

text_blocks.speaker: Chandler Parsons
text_blocks.text: Also that Lakers game was crazy. They're on a minute restriction, like 32 minutes, and with one minute left they literally took them out and threw in the bench. Plus I say when you pull your starters out in an overtime game, I ain't got much to say.

text_blocks.speaker: Chandler Parsons
text_blocks.text: They just took their starters out with one minute left and put guys that hadn't even played in the game. It's the Charlotte standard.

text_blocks.speaker: Michelle Beadle
text_blocks.text: But why the minute? What's the minute restriction for?

text_blocks.speaker: Chandler Parsons
text_blocks.text: Also you think that one minute is going to matter? You have a chance to win a basketball game and they basically just threw it away.

text_blocks.speaker: Lou Williams
text_blocks.text: So why wouldn't you put your best players in?

text_blocks.speaker: DeMarcus Cousins
text_blocks.text: Because they don't want to win the basketball game, y'all. Well, game of the season. 12th game of the season, we're rolling out a minute restriction on a 22-year-old kid? Like come on, bro. He benched Naz Reid in the first quarter because of the Charlotte standard.
